stem.text: A beam of laser light is directed towards a narrow slit.

stem.alt: Square panel with a narrow vertical slit and a dot on the beam at the slit; labels: cross-section of beam of light, panel, slit.

stem.text: After emerging from the other side of the slit, the light then falls on a screen.
What is the pattern of light seen on the screen?

A.alt: Square frame containing a single small grey dot.

B.alt: Square frame containing a short horizontal grey bar.

C.alt: Square frame containing a long vertical grey bar.

D.alt: Square frame containing a large grey filled circle.
